title: MZ Show Custom Parameters in Menus

posts.author: Angy1910
posts.body:
I would like to
hide all or most of the default parameters in Menus and
show the parameters I created with
@Eliaquim
's plugin
EliMZ_CustomParameters
in an order I choose in Menus.
To hide the parameters I have come across
this plugin
by Shiva in
this thread
for MV, but it does not seem to do anything in MZ.
EDIT: I managed to hide the Default Parameters by following
this thread
.
I have yet to find a plugin that lets me show the custom parameters in Menus and have a way to have them in a preferred order. Plugins that work with FOSSIL are good too. I can't use ubfoscated plugins.
If anyone is down to help me I would be most grateful!

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
The first thing You need to find is a plugin that let you edit the parameters you want to show. After that, some javascript knowledge to show each parameter for every actor on the menu.
But that all depends on the plugin that you will use to show/edit the parameters. And how it works.
After that I believe is just a matter of taking a look at the script calls on my plugin documentation.
As far as I know, the only plugin that people manage to do that is one from Visustella. Not aware of any other.
